issues.what: Three of the sixteen pre-registered rules have no support on IS and are untestable: r0_m8 fires on 0 of 4,502 minute IS SETUPs, r0_m6 on 1, r0_f8 on 1 of 832 5-minute IS SETUPs (r0_m2 on 44 = 0.98%). The cause for m8/f8 is a unit error in the 'round guesses in the user's units' claim: sess_range_atr is in ATR14 units and ATR14 on 1-minute bars has IS median 8.82 pts, so the session range an hour in is ~9+ ATR (IS median 15.1, min 1.34 at session start); the only minute row with session_bar >= 60 and n_bos_today == 0 sits at 9.22 ATR. No kept-vs-skipped difference, control percentile or permutation p can be computed for these rules, so the study's statement that all 16 rules are 'to be scored on IS' overstates the deliverable (3 of 8 minute rules dead or near-dead).
